_about: Kit preview layouts, transcribed from the approved boards (405x900 css px, x2.667 = 1080x2400). Elements paint in list order (later = on top; an optional 'z' sorts first). Kinds: kit (UI kit v2 id; 'fallback' = the board's code-drawn look, drawn with a magenta dashed outline while the piece is missing), icon (section D slot; stand-in until the kit has it), sprite (game art under client/RogueStars/Assets/Art/Resources/Art, or standin:<name> from tools/art/kit_standins), text (Lilita One; size/outline/shadow in px), shape (code-drawn on purpose). Rects are [x, y, w, h] at 1080 px.

kit_overrides._about: Per-id overrides of size / 9-slice border / mode parsed from docs/design/ui-kit-v2.md.

extra_ids._about: Ids the kit doc describes without spelling them out: id -> phrase that must appear in ui-kit-v2.md.
extra_ids.slot_glyph_head: 5 white glyphs: head, body, arm, legs, tail
extra_ids.slot_glyph_body: 5 white glyphs: head, body, arm, legs, tail
extra_ids.slot_glyph_arm: 5 white glyphs: head, body, arm, legs, tail
extra_ids.slot_glyph_legs: 5 white glyphs: head, body, arm, legs, tail
extra_ids.slot_glyph_tail: 5 white glyphs: head, body, arm, legs, tail

id_fallbacks._about: If an id has no sprite yet, use another kit id with a tint (one neutral pip_gem tinted per colour).

icons._about: Section D icon slots: doc = phrase from section D of ui-kit-v2.md; standin = drawn until the kit has the id; exists = the art is already in the game (not counted as missing).
